description: This file defines the 'Project' result class for the Coocook application's database schema, including columns, relationships, and methods related to project entities.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Project
classes.description: Represents a project entity in the database with columns, relationships, and methods for project management.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives the project by setting the 'archived' timestamp to current time; throws error if already archived.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Unarchives the project by clearing the 'archived' timestamp; throws error if not archived.

methods.name: dishes
methods.description: Retrieves dishes associated with the project via related meals.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Fetches articles and units, caches their relationships, and returns them, optionally as a list.

methods.name: dish_ingredients
methods.description: Shortcut method to retrieve ingredients from dishes related to the project's meals.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Returns a hashref with counts of related objects such as articles, dishes, meals, etc.

methods.name: is_stale
methods.description: Determines if the project is considered stale based on a pivot date.

methods.name: tags_from_names
methods.description: Retrieves tags matching given names; TODO: autocreate missing tags.

methods.name: organizations_without_permission
methods.description: Returns organizations not associated with the project.

methods.name: other_projects
methods.description: Returns all projects except the current one.

methods.name: users_without_permission
methods.description: Returns users not associated with the project.
